    """Place each model on the GPU whose resulting KVPR is lowest."""

    (lowest max KVPR) is returned.

    orders = [

    Greedy KVPR-minimizing placement: sort models by req_rate/slo descending
    (place highest-pressure models first), then place each model on the GPU
    whose current KVPR (load / free memory) is lowest among GPUs that can
    still fit it in memory.

            raise ValueError("Unable to place all models within GPU memory")
